Previous Next About us SLASA is a trusted tuition centre in Nottingham and has been successfully teaching students since 2007. We provide a tailored service for your children’s unique needs. We have dedicated staff who are well experienced and trained to teach various year groups. In SLASA,  we have a warm and friendly atmosphere to encourage children to learn in a safe environment. All of our courses are personalised to meet the National Curriculum and Curriculum for Excellence. We pride ourselves with teaching children the most efficient ways of learning and boosting their confidence in their school work. We tailor our teachers according to their subject specialism so that they can teach our students with the best knowledge possible. We have previously helped children with entrance exams into Nottingham High School and other private schools within Nottinghamshire as well as help with SATS, GCSEs and A levels. Our dedicated help has proven to help children with low self-esteem and learning difficulties around other children in order to improve their confidence as a young person. We have many locations all over Nottingham providing home tuition, grouped learning and 1 to 1 sessions according to your needs.
